rec.name: Testimonials Carousel Section (Customer Review Cards)
rec.status: Built — design review passed (desktop and mobile); minor polish pending (equal card heights, subtitle legibility), not go-live critical

what.text: A horizontally scrolling section of customer testimonial cards on a dark background. Each card has a round avatar photo, the customer's name with shop or company in brackets (e.g. "Eike (HK Päds)"), a bold one-line headline, a 5-star rating row in green, and an italic quote. The next card is partly visible at the right edge, which signals that the row scrolls. A thin red line runs below the row (probably a scroll or progress indicator). The section has a subtitle above the cards: "See how our customers' shops perform with Sectionfy."

why.text: Real names, photos and shop names make the quotes credible, and the 5-star rows give a quick visual rating signal. The quotes handle typical objections (code quality, price-performance, speed of implementation), so they also reduce perceived risk. The partly visible next card invites scrolling, so more proof gets seen. Showing peers with similar shops adds relevance (social proof by similarity).

how.text: Build it as a section with repeatable blocks, one per testimonial. Each block has an image (avatar), name/company text, headline, star rating (1–5) and a quote (rich text). Lay the cards out in a horizontal scroll-snap or slider container. Size the cards so the next one peeks in at the edge. Add a scroll progress or slider line below. Follow the review feedback: make all cards equal height on desktop to avoid a restless look, and increase the subtitle's contrast and size for readability. On mobile, show roughly one card per view with a peek of the next.

items: Per testimonial block: avatar image, name, company/shop, headline, star count, quote
Card background and text colours (dark theme in screenshot)
Cards per view on desktop and mobile

dependencies.text: No apps or metafields are evident. Content is entered manually in theme-editor blocks. Needs real customer quotes and permission to use photos and names. The slider needs a small JS scroll/slider component in the theme. The screenshot suggests a dark colour scheme.

items: Conversion rate on pages with the section vs. without
Scroll depth to and past the section
Add-to-cart / CTA click-through after the section
Bounce rate and time on page

images.caption: Desktop view of the testimonials row: avatar, name (shop), bold headline, green 5-star row, italic quote; cards have uneven heights, the next card peeks in at the right edge, and a red line runs below.
Card structure (avatar, name/company, headline, stars, quote) shows the content fields to configure per block.
